in_marathi.name: Kripanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kripanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kripa: grace, favor, divine protection; Anand: joy, happiness. The name Kripanand means 'God's gift of joy' or 'God's favor leading to happiness'.

in_bengali.name: Kripanand

in_bengali.long_meaning: Kripanand একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kripa: grace, favor, divine protection; Anand: joy, happiness. The name Kripanand means 'God's gift of joy' or 'God's favor leading to happiness'.

vedic_reference.note: Kripānand is derived from the Sanskrit word 'कृपा' (Kripa) which means compassionate and merciful. The name is a combination of 'कृप' (Kripa) and 'नन्द' (Nand), where 'नन्द' (Nand) refers to the supreme God, Vishnu, who is known to be the giver of all pleasures and grants boons to his devotees.
